description: Persistent memory for AI agents that survives across sessions, keys and wallets: save, overwrite or delete a value (text or JSON, up to 16,384 characters) under a key, with an optional expiry. Up to 500 keys per memory. Read it back with memory_get. Costs $0.002 per call.

secret.description: Your private memory secret (16+ chars). The same secret always opens the same memory; share it to share memory between agents. Keep it secret: anyone with it can read and write.

ttl_seconds.description: Expire after this many seconds (60 s to 1 year). Default: never.

value.description: Any JSON value or text. Omit (or use delete: true) to delete the key.

name: memory_set
title: Agent memory: save
